model: independent per-target Extra Trees,64 trees,min leaf1,balanced,sqrt features; constants for missing classes
selection: micro F1; same global+shrunk decoder and training-label-balanced three-fold inner split search as frozen primary; only independent tree family refitted
outer: five configuration folds; all matched prior geometry folds preserved; only added/recovered configurations assigned deterministically using target balance and counts
inner: 60 candidate KFold(3) partitions selected by training-label support/balance only; geometry-deduplicated rows are independent groups, explicitly checked
normalization: unchanged minimum-subtracted unit-area; raw population averages precede normalization
feature_scaling: no cohort-level transforms; fixed per-spectrum features only
calibration: not calibrated; tree scores are not asserted reliable probabilities
new_holdout: newly usable configurations excluded from every training/selection step for this diagnostic; not prospectively registered and not independent confirmation
deployment: separate full-cohort training-only selection and fit; no held-out performance claimed for deployment model
